subject.title: improve: let Code Mode use declared tool result shapes

question: Should `outputSchema` become the supported public plugin API for describing and validating `AgentToolResult.details` across Code Mode and Tool Search?
rationale: The patch creates a shipped external plugin contract whose permanence, validation semantics, and future compatibility obligations cannot be selected safely from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Approve after blockers
options.body: Adopt `outputSchema` as the canonical optional API after fixing normalization and transcript-projection ordering and adding focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Limit declared result shapes to internal trusted tools until the external plugin contract and upgrade obligations are designed separately.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Pause this PR and retain unknown-output behavior if the long-term plugin API cost is not currently justified.

recommendation.title: Approve after blockers
recommendation.body: Adopt `outputSchema` as the canonical optional API after fixing normalization and transcript-projection ordering and adding focused compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available history-based owner because they introduced and maintained the recent Code Mode catalog-performance sequence, though final product approval still requires qualifying maintainer authority.
